newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria shares run out of steam ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Austria shares run out of steam ahead of holiday.

text.p: Austrian shares failed to extend a three-day winning streak on Wednesday as the ATX index ended 0.47 percent shy of Tuesday's record close.
Dealers said profit-taking had knocked the ATX into negative territory after a promising start but noted a small downward correction was to be expected after heady gains.
Jitters ahead of Sunday's French election run-off had also extended to the Vienna market, which will be closed for a holiday on Thursday.
"The French are stirring up some uncertainty but overall the positive trend in Vienna remains intact," a trader said.
The ATX blue-chip index closed 6.11 points down at 1,304.59 with five shares up and 16 down.
Market participants saw support in the region 1,270-1,280 points and resistance at 1,330 points. "But if the ATX really takes off, there isn't any technical resistance to speak of," one added.
Insurer Wiener Staedtische was the day's leading gainer. Its shares rose 11 schillings, or 2.39 percent, to 1,034 schillings.
Preferred shares in Bank Austria were the biggest decliner for the second straight day. They fell seven schillings, or 1.61 percent, to 429 schillings.
On Tuesday, Vienna City Council agreed to relinquish indirect control of the bank when it ruled Vienna holding company AVZ should sell its voting stake of around 44 percent over the next six years.
June ATX futures stood six points down at 1,305. The broad-based Vienna bourse indexfell 1.72 points to 478.83.
